needs_you.label: Needs you
needs_you.caption: Needs your OK
needs_you.unmistakable: shape badge (exclamation mark on a ringed disc) + a calm double hop + big eyes looking straight at you; never shown by colour alone, and the app pairs it with its own text

reduced_motion.summary: Each state holds a still pose: no hops, bobs, breathing, shakes, nods, rocking, taps or scanning. Gaze may still follow touch or the pointer, blinks stay, badges show without animating, and state changes crossfade over 0.25 s. done shows its happy face for one_shot seconds, then crossfades back.
